mapper.select: SELECT to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS d, COUNT(*) AS c FROM user_feedback WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start} GROUP BY to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY d

SELECT intent_type AS intent_type, SUM(CASE WHEN is_liked = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS liked_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_liked = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disliked_count FROM user_feedback WHERE deleted = 0 AND intent_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY intent_type ORDER BY intent_type
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_liked = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS liked_count FROM user_feedback WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start}

INSERT INTO user_feedback (id, user_id, session_id, message_id, is_liked, intent_type) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{isLiked}, #{intentType}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, message_id) WHERE deleted = 0 DO UPDATE SET is_liked = EXCLUDED.is_liked, intent_type = EXCLUDED.intent_type RETURNING id, user_id, session_id, message_id, is_liked, intent_type, created_at
